title: Euler Rig
description: A feature-rich adventure centered on technology, exploration, optimization, and nature. Built for NeoForge 1.21.1
body:
Euler Rig offers many in-depth technology additions that flush out mid-game play. The pack also provides exploration improvements for those who are less interested in heavy tech mods like create. Combinations of more mobs, terrain generation improvements, and many new structures provide a full experience for those who wish to wander and explore.

This modpack is the clientside download and offers full compatability with the server linked in the modpack once you launch it. Refer to the in-server guidebook to understand some of the mod offerings specific to the server. Simply download this modpack into a 1.21.1 neoforge instance and join.


### Features:
- Optimization: FPS should have a measureable increase over base game
- Cameras: Use film or instant cameras to document your experience
- Aquatic Life: Explore new aquatic ecosystems and fish for more food than ever
- Nature: The biomes you will explore are filled with more life than ever
- Create: Automate nearly everything, bring advanced industries to life
- Magic: Learn spells and defeat new enemies to grow your magic power
- Decoration: Add more detail than ever to your builds using new textures or copycat blocks
- Storage: Use multiple different storage systems and backpacks to streamline your experience
